description: This file defines the 'Note' entity class for a note management system, mapped to a 'notes' database table using JPA annotations. It includes fields for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, with getter and setter methods for each. The class utilizes Hibernate-specific annotations for automatically setting timestamps.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note record with fields for id, title, content, creation and update timestamps, including appropriate JPA annotations and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the note's id (managed by JPA).

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the note was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the last update to the note.
